title: Senior Technical Recruiter, Research
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. Achieving this requires bringing the world’s most exceptional talent under one roof to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Our Research Recruiting team plays a critical role in this effort. We are an embedded part of the research organization—working side by side with our research staff to deeply understand evolving priorities, build trust, and strategically shape the future of OpenAI’s talent.

About the Role

You will design and execute innovative, long-term talent strategies to identify and attract the world’s leading and emerging AI researchers, engineers, and scientific builders. You will partner directly with research leadership to define talent needs, shape search strategies, guide hiring decisions, and ensure OpenAI continues to hire the brightest minds advancing safe frontier-model research.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and we follow a hybrid schedule of three days in the office per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a strategic talent partner to executives and hiring leaders; build a deep understanding of business priorities and long-term organizational design needs; and evolve technical roadmaps to anticipate and shape hiring plans.

  • Identify, engage, and cultivate exceptional talent across industry leaders and emerging research communities.

  • Use data and insights to influence hiring and compensation strategy, benchmarking, talent pipeline decisions, and process improvements; share market intel to help leaders make informed decisions on timing, leveling, compensation, and search design.

  • Partner closely with hiring teams on interview strategy, candidate evaluation, closing narratives, and long-term talent mapping, serve as a trusted advisor on the talent quality bar and signals.

  • Collaborate deeply with your sourcing partner to accelerate search execution and build talent.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are extremely passionate about embedding yourself in the AI research community and finding, selecting, and securing the best talent in the world for OpenAI.

  • Have 8+ years of recruiting experience across highly technical and specialized domains.

  • Navigate and close complex offer negotiations with confidence, prioritizing long-term relationship building and balancing candidate motivations, market dynamics, and compensation frameworks.

  • Are deeply interested in artificial intelligence and its potential for positive impact on humanity.

  • Lead creative and strategic search approaches for highly specialized technical roles.

  • Take initiatives from ideation to execution while collaborating with a diverse set of stakeholders.

  • Learn quickly and thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment with shifting priorities.

About OpenAI

title: Fullstack Engineer, Child Safety Tools & Systems
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Intelligence & Investigations Engineering team builds systems that detect, analyze, and disrupt abuse across OpenAI’s products. We partner closely with the Child Safety team and cross-functional groups to protect users while advancing OpenAI’s goal of developing AI that benefits everyone.

About the Role

As a Fullstack Engineer focused on child safety, you’ll build data-intensive, AI-powered applications and infrastructure that enable operators and investigators to work effectively and responsibly. You’ll adapt quickly in ambiguous, fast-moving environments to deliver well-crafted, reliable tooling for high-severity safety work.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Candidates should understand this role involves exposure to sensitive and egregious content.

In this role, you will:

  • Prototype, build, and maintain intelligence systems that detect, triage, and enable efficient human review of possible high severity harm

  • Work hand in hand with operators and investigators, designing and delivering systems that enable them to do their work faster, more accurately, and more safely.

  • Develop across the stack: UIs, services, pipelines, and anything else required to solve the problems we face.

  • Interact with partners across Product Policy, Platform Integrity, Safety Systems, and Research

  • Contribute to the team’s technical strategy, especially for child safety related tools and systems

  • Report on impact in a data-driven fashion

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation and enjoy owning systems end-to-end—from infrastructure and data ingestion to frontend tooling

  • Are energized by working at the frontier of AI capabilities, integrating new models and APIs into practical systems

  • Have experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines or search/retrieval systems

  • Are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, and familiar with tools like Spark, Kafka, Flink, data warehouses, and SQL

  • Take a product-minded approach, design with user workflows in mind, and iterate quickly based on feedback

  • Favor pragmatic solutions and can ship in hacky, low-support environments when needed

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and open-ended problem spaces with evolving goals

  • Have prior experience working on engineering for high-severity harms

  • Bring intuition for the pain points and workflows of operations and investigative teams, and curiosity about solving complex investigations

  • Bonus: prior knowledge of child-safety-specific challenges such as secure handling of quarantined content and reporting to NCMEC

title: Strategic Finance, Hardware Product Finance
descriptionHtml:
About OpenAI

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals together under one organization to accomplish this.

We're building the most advanced AI models and platforms, making it easy for developers and customers to benefit from AI via our suite of products.

As OpenAI expands into hardware devices, success requires world-class financial stewardship across the entire product cost stack, from concept through launch and lifecycle cost optimization.

About the Team

The Strategic Finance team provides financial insights and guidance to support the organization's long-term goals and strategies. We partner across the business to allocate and deploy our resources for the highest impact outcomes.

About the Role

title: Recruiting Systems and Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

At OpenAI, we’re building safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. That mission depends on hiring exceptional people across research, engineering, product, policy, and operations — at scale, globally, and with a high bar for quality.

The Recruiting Operations team provides the systems, workflows, and data foundation that power that hiring. Within Recruiting Operations, the Systems & Enablement team owns the recruiting technology ecosystem — ensuring our ATS, offer workflows, and connected tools are reliable, well-governed, and user centric.

We are building a team of Systems & Enablement Leads who together operate, evolve, and support the tooling ecosystem that runs hiring at OpenAI.

About the Role

As a Systems & Enablement Lead, you will be one of the core owners of OpenAI’s recruiting systems. You’ll be responsible for a set of workflows, tools, and operational domains within our ATS and recruiting platform, while partnering closely with recruiters, coordinators, People Analytics, HR Operations, Legal, and IT.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys being deep in systems while also driving clarity, training, and consistency across a large organization. You’ll help ensure that recruiting teams can move fast within reliable systems and processes — and that the data and workflows behind every hire are accurate and reliable.

What You’ll Do

Operate and Improve Recruiting Systems

  • Serve as an administrator for OpenAI’s ATS (Ashby) and connected recruiting tools

  • Configure and maintain recruiting workflows, pipelines, fields, permissions, and integrations for your assigned domains

  • Partner with teammates on the Systems & Enablement team to maintain shared standards and coverage

  • Work with vendors on support, enhancements, and feature adoption

Ensure Data Quality and Workflow Integrity

  • Own the accuracy and completeness of data in your areas of the recruiting lifecycle

  • Partner with People Analytics to ensure reporting fields and pipelines are trustworthy

  • Design and implement guardrails that prevent incorrect or inconsistent data entry

  • Audit and monitor recruiting systems to quickly surface and resolve issues.

Support and Troubleshoot

  • Participate in the Recruiting Operations support queue (Slack and Jira)

  • Troubleshoot complex system issues across tools, permissions, and integrations

  • Collaborate with IT, vendors, and teammates to resolve problems quickly

  • Turn recurring issues into durable fixes through configuration, automation, or documentation

Enablement & Change Management

  • Create and maintain SOPs, training, and documentation for the workflows you own

  • Lead enablement sessions and onboarding for recruiters and coordinators

  • Support releases of new workflows, features, and policy updates

  • Help ensure changes are adopted and understood across the organization

  • Measure adoption and workflow health to ensure changes are landing as intended

Offer & Agreement Workflows

  • Support offer and agreement processes and creation in partnership with Legal, HR Ops, and Compensation

  • Maintain templates, approvals, and system logic that ensure offers are issued correctly

  • Assist with complex or non-standard offers through governed workflows

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify friction, inefficiencies, and scaling challenges in the system

  • Propose and implement improvements that make recruiting faster, more consistent, and more reliable

  • Stay current on tool capabilities and recommend ways to better use them

We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, HR systems, people technology, or related roles

  • Hands-on experience administering an ATS (Ashby strongly preferred)

  • Strong understanding of recruiting workflows, offers, and hiring data

  • Ability to balance detailed system work with user support and enablement

  • Strong communication and stakeholder partnership skills

  • Comfort working in fast-moving, evolving environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting global or multi-entity hiring

  • Familiarity with compliance-sensitive or highly regulated workflows

  • Experience creating training and documentation for operational teams

  • Experience working with analytics or downstream HR systems

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Enterprise Product Manager - Financials
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team at OpenAI builds and scales the future-proof systems and data architecture that power our core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across quote-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, and asset management for both B2B and B2C. Our focus is on modernizing workflows through strategic integrations, scalable automation, and seamless data flows—empowering smarter decisions, reliable reporting, and sustainable growth as OpenAI evolves.

About the Role

We are seeking an Enterprise Product Manager – Financials to own and scale OpenAI’s Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platform across financial close, consolidation, account reconciliation, profitability, and master-data governance.

This role is responsible for ensuring that FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS, and EDM operate as a single, trusted financial system of record, tightly integrated with Oracle Fusion ERP, Revenue, and our data platform.

This leader owns product strategy, roadmap, data integrity, controls, and automation for the entire financial close and consolidation ecosystem as OpenAI scales globally and prepares for audit, compliance, and IPO readiness.

In this role, you will:

  • Execution & Leadership

    • Drive the execution and continuous improvement of OpenAI’s Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platform, including FCCS, ARCS, EDM, and PCMCS, ensuring financial accuracy, auditability, scalability, and enterprise-grade governance.

    • Lead the delivery of global close, consolidation, and reporting capabilities, enabling timely, reliable, and compliant financial results across multiple entities, currencies, and accounting standards.

    • Execute the integration strategy between Oracle Fusion ERP, EPM, and the enterprise data platform, ensuring automated, controlled, and reconcilable financial data flows.

    • Ensure SOX-grade controls and audit readiness across financial close, reconciliations, master data, and adjustments through standardized workflows, approvals, and certifications.

    • Drive operational excellence across the EPM ecosystem, reducing manual processes, close cycle time, and post-close adjustments through automation and data quality enforcement.

    • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Audit leadership to deliver scalable financial systems that support OpenAI’s rapid growth and regulatory obligations.

    • Provide execution leadership across cross-functional teams, aligning Finance, Product, Data, and Engineering to deliver high-impact financial systems initiatives on time and at enterprise quality.

    • Build and mature the Finance Systems product organization, setting standards for delivery, reliability, documentation, and platform ownership across the EPM stack.

  • Systems Ownership

    • Own end-to-end design and delivery for financial close, consolidation, account reconciliations, profitability, financial master-data governance, and enterprise financial reporting across FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS, and EDM.

    • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Audit teams to create trustworthy, auditable, single-source-of-truth financial and management reporting datasets, including standard financial statements, executive dashboards, and narrative reporting.

    • Drive integrations with upstream and downstream systems including Oracle Fusion ERP, Revenue platforms, Databricks, planning tools, and reporting platforms, ensuring automated, controlled, and reconcilable data flows that power statutory, management, and narrative reporting.

  • Operational Excellence

    • Deliver reliable, on-time financial close, consolidation, and reporting across FCCS, ARCS, EDM, and PCMCS through automation, standardization, and SOX-grade controls.

    • Continuously improve data quality, reconciliation integrity, and close efficiency by eliminating manual processes and enforcing governed, auditable workflows.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Deep hands-on expertise across Oracle EPM Cloud including FCCS, ARCS, EDM, PCMCS, and Data Management, with a strong understanding of close, consolidation, and reporting.

  • A strong foundation in financial accounting, FX, intercompany, ownership, and consolidation, and the ability to translate those into governed system design.

  • Experience owning enterprise financial platforms as products, including roadmap, controls, data contracts, and stakeholder alignment.

  • A proven track record delivering SOX-compliant, audit-ready financial systems in high-growth or pre-IPO environments.

  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous, and rapidly scaling environment, with the ability to prioritize, adapt, and deliver under tight deadlines.

  • The ability to design and run automated ERP-to-EPM-to-analytics pipelines (Oracle Fusion, Databricks, planning and reporting tools).

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Audit, and Engineering.

  • A bias toward clarity, control, and financial truth, replacing spreadsheets and manual processes with governed, automated systems.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with Databricks, Anaplan, or Workato/OIC integration platforms.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, SLA, AR, AP, FA) and how it integrates with FCCS, ARCS, EDM, and PCMCS.

  • Exposure to agentic AI and automation in EPM

  • Background working with Finance, Engineering, and Data teams in fast-scaling or pre-IPO environments.

title: IT Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

IT Systems Operations is the operational layer within Security and IT that connects core teams and keeps employee-facing workflows, systems, and tools running reliably across the Employee Technology & Experience program. We design and implement the workflows, automations, and integrations that power the employee lifecycle, access, ITIL processes, and core business systems, partnering closely with Security and cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that work end to end.

Our mandate spans solution design, system implementation, workflow engineering, automation, and the reliability of the platforms behind employee-facing processes. We work closely with Support to resolve complex issues, refine workflows, and ensure our solutions perform reliably in real-world conditions. We turn operational problems into scalable, engineered systems that reduce friction, codify patterns, and help OpenAI grow predictably and securely.

About the Role

As a Solutions Engineer, you will design and implement scalable, ITIL-aligned workflows using OpenAI technology and models to automate and improve core IT processes. You will deliver cross-functional solutions from requirements and architecture through build, rollout, and operationalization across ITSM, IAM, SaaS platforms, identity-adjacent systems, lifecycle automation, access workflows, integrations, and enterprise orchestration.

You will reduce operational toil by building durable automations that ensure systems behave consistently, predictably, and securely. You will also work closely with IT Support Operations to eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, and equip Support with the least-privilege access needed to operate effectively.

This is an on-site role based in our San Francisco office with a minimum presence of three days per week.

In this role, you will:

Solution Design and Implementation

  • Translate unclear requirements into structured workflows and dependable systems.

  • Build integrations across identity, SaaS, ITSM, internal applications, and endpoints.

  • Deliver implementations from architecture through rollout and documentation.

Support Partnership

  • Address recurring issues with targeted workflow and system improvements.

  • Equip Support with training, Playbooks, and long-term administrative patterns.

  • Manage on-call rotations and technical escalations across IT and Security.

Workflow, Automation, and Orchestration

  • Build automated request flows across Slack, ChatGPT, Atlas, Jira, Linear, Incident.io, and Retool.

  • Use APIs, Terraform, scripting, and low-code tools to remove manual effort.

ITIL Application and Management

  • Maintain Incident, Request, Change, and Problem workflows across modern ITSM tools.

  • Provide repeatable workflow templates for teams across the company.

Integrations

  • Execute user, device, and SaaS integration playbooks.

  • Lead identity, access, and ITSM migrations during acquisitions.

System Administration

  • Maintain lifecycle, collaboration, and automation platforms such as Slack Grid, Google Workspace, Atlassian, and GitHub.

  • Ensure system reliability through monitoring, logging, workflow health, and integration upkeep.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Instinctively break down messy, ambiguous processes and turn them into clear, logical, well-structured systems.

  • Navigate technical and non-technical teams with ease, translating needs and aligning stakeholders without friction.

  • Identify patterns, eliminate repetition, and design solutions that scale rather than relying on manual effort.

  • Understand identity as a foundation of enterprise architecture and think holistically about trust, entitlements, and lifecycle flows.

  • Adapt quickly to new tools, understand how systems fit together, and enjoy learning the inner workings of enterprise platforms.

  • Think in systems naturally and identify where data or workflows break down, and design clean, resilient cross-system connections.

  • You appreciate structured frameworks like ITIL and Agile, using them to bring order, predictability, and continuous improvement.

  • You communicate clearly through runbooks and written guidance that help others move faster and reduce institutional knowledge gaps.

title: AI Adoption Manager - San Francisco
descriptionHtml:
About the team

Our AI Adoption & Deployment team at OpenAI is dedicated to partnering with our customers to realize business value through deployment of OpenAI’s offerings. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. We see every interaction is an opportunity to inspire and accelerate a company or a person on their AI journey.

About the role

We are looking for a seasoned AI Adoption Manager to join our Strategic Accounts team, working with our largest, most complex, and innovative Enterprise customers. You are crucial to the success of our largest customer(s) and will be instrumental in driving adoption, consumption and value of OpenAI’s offerings, ultimately responsible for understanding our customer’s needs and delivering an excellent experience. You will collaborate closely with the Sales, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Engineering teams.

The ideal candidate for this role will have a successful track record of managing and growing Fortune 500 customers, delivering strategic advice, and driving customer success. You must understand the motivation, business drivers, strategic goals and desired business outcomes for your portfolio of large enterprise customers (typically 1-3). You will lead a cross-functional partnership across your named customer(s) and identify new ways our platform can differentiate them in the market.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ or remote in NYC. We offer relocation support to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Advise and partner with the world’s largest and most complex enterprises to drive AI adoption and business transformation with OpenAI’s offerings.

  • Create and implement customer success plans that outline goals, potential challenges, KPIs, and timelines.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

  • Travel ~15% of the time, to develop and nurture strong customer relationships to understand their business goals and needs.

  • Strategize and execute initiatives to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

  • Own the relationship with Product for these largest customers who are pushing the product’s boundaries.

  • Be an AI thought leader with customers and pair this with deep industry specific expertise to help drive this transformative technology. Work as an internal leader to share and scale those insights and frameworks to the CS team.

  • Implement and run use case development and enablement sessions that can scale across multiple regions and lines of business.

  • Gather and relay customer feedback to internal stakeholders, and identify themes across customers to incorporate into product planning.

  • Collaborate closely with the Sales team to ensure seamless handoff between pre- and post-sale.

  • Anticipate at-risk renewals or user churn and collaborate with the relevant internal teams to devise corrective action plans.

  • Foster customer advocacy and facilitate customer testimonials and case studies.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience in a customer facing roles, preferably working with a technical enterprise product.

  • Have 5+ years managing relationships with large, global, and complex organizations.

  • Experience working with global 1000 Enterprise customers with multiple stakeholders, and managing success programs as the key advisor to global as well as regional customer organizations.

  • Highly skilled at building deep and broad relationships across a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Have experience being a thought leader with your customer base.

  • Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when engaging with executives and leaders.

  • Expertly communicate technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders

  • Can proactively identify pain points in the product and with our customers.

  • Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to make both your team and our customers succeed.

  • Operate with high horsepower, have strong problem-solving skills, are adept at frequent context switching, effectively manage working on multiple projects at once with expansive ownership, and ruthlessly prioritize.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and ethical evolution of AI.

title: Anaplan Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team at OpenAI builds and scales the future-proof systems and data architecture that power our core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, supply chain, financial planning, workforce management, and asset management for both B2B and B2C. Our focus is on modernizing workflows through strategic integrations, scalable automation, and seamless data flows—empowering smarter decisions, reliable reporting, and sustainable growth as OpenAI evolves.

About the Role

As an Anaplan Solutions Architect, you’ll serve as the primary owner of OpenAI’s Anaplan platform, shaping its roadmap and driving its evolution to support our rapidly scaling business. You’ll design and maintain the models that power our operating plans, workforce forecasts, and strategic decision-making, ensuring they are accurate, performant, and aligned with evolving business needs. You’ll manage and optimize inbound and outbound data integrations to keep Anaplan seamlessly connected to the broader finance and data ecosystem, enabling automated, trusted data flows across the company. You’ll work directly with stakeholders to triage bugs and intake enhancement requests, operating as a key driver of the finance team’s output.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Strategic Finance, Accounting, People, and other cross-functional partners to translate planning and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable model enhancements. You’ll support monthly forecasting and reporting cycles by building new capabilities, improving existing processes, and delivering insights that help leadership make better decisions, faster. This is a hands-on, high-impact role at the intersection of technology and finance — ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex planning challenges and wants to help shape the financial infrastructure behind one of the world’s most ambitious technology companies.

This role combines hands-on technical execution with strategic impact, driving reliable, scalable, and compliant integrations that support OpenAI’s growth and financial operations.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of Anaplan models that power financial planning, workforce forecasting, budgeting, and long-range strategic modeling.

  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable, well-structured models and system configurations that support evolving planning and reporting needs.

  • Partner with Strategic Finance, Accounting, and People teams to deliver enhancements that improve forecast accuracy, planning flexibility, and decision-making capabilities.

  • Design and manage robust data pipelines and integrations between Anaplan, Oracle, Workday, and other enterprise systems, ensuring seamless, reliable data flow.

  • Diagnose and resolve model and integration issues — including data mismatches, calculation errors, and performance bottlenecks — while continuously improving stability and reliability.

  • Implement governance, access controls, and metadata management practices that support security, audit readiness, and SOX compliance across the platform.

  • Build and maintain scenario planning tools, driver-based models, and advanced analytics capabilities to enable better business insights and strategic decisions.

  • Document model structures, integration architectures, operational runbooks, and technical processes to ensure long-term maintainability and knowledge sharing.

  • Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, and reporting cycles by delivering accurate data, timely model updates, and technical expertise throughout each planning phase.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining Anaplan models, including completion of official Anaplan certification programs (Model Builder, Solution Architect), with Master Anaplanner certification strongly preferred.

  • Proven success designing and maintaining scalable, well-structured planning models that support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range strategic planning.

  • Deep understanding of model architecture best practices, including driver-based planning, scenario modeling, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience building and managing data pipelines and integrations between planning platforms and source systems (Oracle, Workday, etc), leveraging APIs, ETL, or iPaaS solutions.

  • A strong grasp of accounting and finance principles, including budgeting, revenue forecasting, workforce planning, and multi-entity consolidation.

  • Experience supporting monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles — including reconciliation, data validation, and parallel run operations.

  • Exceptional documentation skills and the ability to produce clear technical specifications, modeling standards, and user guides.

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance requirements, security best practices, and audit readiness as they relate to planning systems.

  • A track record of success in dynamic, high-growth environments where scalability, accuracy, and reliability are critical.

  • A curiosity-driven approach to technology, with a passion for exploring new modeling techniques, data frameworks, and system capabilities to improve planning outcomes.

About OpenAI

About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team at OpenAI builds and scales the future-proof systems and data architecture that power our core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, supply chain, financial planning, workforce management, and asset management for both B2B and B2C. Our focus is on modernizing workflows through strategic integrations, scalable automation, and seamless data flows—empowering smarter decisions, reliable reporting, and sustainable growth as OpenAI evolves.

About the Role

As an Anaplan Solutions Architect, you’ll serve as the primary owner of OpenAI’s Anaplan platform, shaping its roadmap and driving its evolution to support our rapidly scaling business. You’ll design and maintain the models that power our operating plans, workforce forecasts, and strategic decision-making, ensuring they are accurate, performant, and aligned with evolving business needs. You’ll manage and optimize inbound and outbound data integrations to keep Anaplan seamlessly connected to the broader finance and data ecosystem, enabling automated, trusted data flows across the company. You’ll work directly with stakeholders to triage bugs and intake enhancement requests, operating as a key driver of the finance team’s output.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Strategic Finance, Accounting, People, and other cross-functional partners to translate planning and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable model enhancements. You’ll support monthly forecasting and reporting cycles by building new capabilities, improving existing processes, and delivering insights that help leadership make better decisions, faster. This is a hands-on, high-impact role at the intersection of technology and finance — ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex planning challenges and wants to help shape the financial infrastructure behind one of the world’s most ambitious technology companies.

This role combines hands-on technical execution with strategic impact, driving reliable, scalable, and compliant integrations that support OpenAI’s growth and financial operations.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of Anaplan models that power financial planning, workforce forecasting, budgeting, and long-range strategic modeling.

 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, well-structured models and system configurations that support evolving planning and reporting needs.

 - Partner with Strategic Finance, Accounting, and People teams to deliver enhancements that improve forecast accuracy, planning flexibility, and decision-making capabilities.

 - Design and manage robust data pipelines and integrations between Anaplan, Oracle, Workday, and other enterprise systems, ensuring seamless, reliable data flow.

 - Diagnose and resolve model and integration issues — including data mismatches, calculation errors, and performance bottlenecks — while continuously improving stability and reliability.

 - Implement governance, access controls, and metadata management practices that support security, audit readiness, and SOX compliance across the platform.

 - Build and maintain scenario planning tools, driver-based models, and advanced analytics capabilities to enable better business insights and strategic decisions.

 - Document model structures, integration architectures, operational runbooks, and technical processes to ensure long-term maintainability and knowledge sharing.

 - Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, and reporting cycles by delivering accurate data, timely model updates, and technical expertise throughout each planning phase.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining Anaplan models, including completion of official Anaplan certification programs (Model Builder, Solution Architect), with Master Anaplanner certification strongly preferred.

 - Proven success designing and maintaining scalable, well-structured planning models that support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range strategic planning.

 - Deep understanding of model architecture best practices, including driver-based planning, scenario modeling, and performance optimization techniques.

 - Hands-on experience building and managing data pipelines and integrations between planning platforms and source systems (Oracle, Workday, etc), leveraging APIs, ETL, or iPaaS solutions.

 - A strong grasp of accounting and finance principles, including budgeting, revenue forecasting, workforce planning, and multi-entity consolidation.

 - Experience supporting monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles — including reconciliation, data validation, and parallel run operations.

 - Exceptional documentation skills and the ability to produce clear technical specifications, modeling standards, and user guides.

 - Familiarity with SOX compliance requirements, security best practices, and audit readiness as they relate to planning systems.

 - A track record of success in dynamic, high-growth environments where scalability, accuracy, and reliability are critical.

 - A curiosity-driven approach to technology, with a passion for exploring new modeling techniques, data frameworks, and system capabilities to improve planning outcomes.
